data.title: Increase in health insurance contributions from January 2027
data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that her monthly contributions to statutory health and long-term care insurance (as a voluntarily insured member) will rise to €318.46 from 1 January 2027, due to the fund's new additional contribution rate and her income shown in the 2025 tax assessment.
data.explanation: Your health insurer is raising your monthly contribution to €318.46 starting 1 January 2027, because of a higher additional contribution rate and your reported income. If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the fund in writing — the app will show the exact deadline. If you do nothing, the new amount becomes final and will continue to be collected by direct debit. The contribution is debited monthly, around the 15th of the following month, so make sure your account has enough funds.
